## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the exact commands and results. Identify checks that skipped or could
not run, including whether GPU hardware or multiple MPI ranks were exercised.
For numerical changes, include the independent reference or derivation,
units, tolerances, and sampling limits. For performance changes, include a
reproducible comparison with hardware and accuracy settings.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the PR title follows [COMMIT_RULES.md](https://github.com/ricardoleal20/modena/blob/main/COMMIT_RULES.md).
- [ ] Relevant tests and checks passed, or unavailable checks are explained above.
- [ ] Regression coverage and documentation were updated where applicable.
- [ ] Numerical or performance claims include appropriate evidence where applicable.
- [ ] Changes to validated scope, compatibility, or physical interpretation are documented where applicable.
- [ ] I can contribute this work under the project's MIT license and have preserved third-party notices.
